text: Alliance About & Governance ⬛️ CHERI in SoC WG ⬛️ CHERI in SoC WG Brings together the architecture, integration, and verification questions involved in adding CHERI to a system-on-chip. The CHERI in SoC Working Group focuses on defining and standardizing what needs to be included in a system to support CHERI, and to provide useful resources to speed the wider adoption of CHERI within chiplets and SoCs. The resources we deliver will help accelerate: Learning what is involved when creating a device or system that supports CHERI. Understanding the different levels of CHERI support, and what guarantees they can offer. Making the right trade-offs and choices for the devices and systems being developed. Extending or innovating technologies to better enable CHERI at the system level. The CHERI in SoC Working Group focuses on defining and standardizing what needs to be included in a system to support CHERI, and to provide useful resources to speed the wider adoption of CHERI within chiplets and SoCs.
The resources we deliver will help accelerate:
Learning what is involved when creating a device or system that supports CHERI.
Understanding the different levels of CHERI support, and what guarantees they can offer.
Making the right trade-offs and choices for the devices and systems being developed.
Extending or innovating technologies to better enable CHERI at the system level.
